name.en: Annadata Sukhibhava (AP state top-up for farmers)

summary.en: Rs.20,000 per year in total: Rs.6,000 from PM-KISAN plus Rs.14,000 from the Andhra Pradesh government, in three instalments

benefit.value_note: Rs.14,000 is the state top-up. Landowners also receive Rs.6,000 from PM-KISAN, making Rs.20,000

en: Landowner farmers must be registered under PM-KISAN.
Complete your e-KYC and other requirements at your nearest Rythu Seva Kendra.
Check your payment status on the Annadata Sukhibhava portal or the Mana Mitra WhatsApp governance service, or contact your district Agriculture Department officials.

to_confirm: Sources differ on whether the scheme is for small and marginal farmers only or all farmers, and on how much tenant farmers receive; confirm at your Rythu Seva Kendra

sources.title: Annadata Sukhibhava scheme (Vikaspedia, Govt of India; cites AP Agriculture Department)
PTI report quoting AP government release (29 Jul 2025)
